text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Here we finally are at the stage of my<n>showdown
against the Mejiro<n>family—the Hanshin Juvenile
Fillies!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
What kind of advantages do you get<n>when you're
born into a family?<n>None! That's right, we're all
equal in<n>the grand scheme of things!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Even if the divine dares to claim that<n>differences in
the environment one is<n>raised in leads to
differences in<n>strength...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: I choose to staunchly disagree! Sohere I go, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Seeking the Pearl turns away from<n>me and heads
toward the paddock.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Pearl, you're here. Here's to a good<n>race today.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
As a representative of the Mejiro<n>family, I vow to
perform better than<n>you.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
I see you've come shouldering the<n>familial bonds
of your house, Dober.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
But you aren't the only one—I have<n>my own bonds
as well.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: You do? That's a bit surprising.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Well, they're a work in progress, so<n>I'm not
surprised you haven't<n>noticed.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
But mark my words! My bonds will<n>only grow
stronger from here on out!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
The connections I share... are with all<n>the people I
don't know.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: I'm sorry?

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: You aren't limited to only formingbonds with people in your family. Justbecause you were born with a set ofpowerful connections...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Doesn't mean you can't create new<n>ones with
other people! And those<n>bonds can become even
stronger<n>than your existing ones!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
In today's race, I'm going to prove to<n>you that
when it comes to our<n>running, the playing field is
completely<n>level.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Pearl...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
That's bold... I don't know any other<n>Umamusume
who thinks like that.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
But that's all the more reason why I<n>must do better
than you here at the<n>final race of our junior year!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Sounds good! Bring it on, Dober! ♪

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Family doesn't need to be so<n>narrowly defined.
Holding this belief<n>close to her heart, Seeking the
Pearl<n>takes on the Hanshin Juvenile Fillies.
